hut_to_empire

Layout: diagonal split screen. Left half dark and dusty: the noob standing sadly in front of a tiny straw hut with one coin. Right half bright and golden: the bacon hair standing proud in front of a huge royal palace with blue crown banners and piles of gold. A glowing arrow-free diagonal light seam divides them. Title across the top: "FROM HUT TO EMPIRE"
capture_capitals

Layout: low camera angle looking up. The bacon hair plants a big blue crown flag into a miniature capital city on a giant tabletop world map, a toppled red enemy flag falling beside it, tiny buildings and a red target ring around the city. Title on the left side stacked in two lines: "CAPTURE CAPITALS"
send_convoys

A parchment world map fills the frame with a glowing dotted trade route arcing across the ocean; along the route a camel caravan, a sailing galley and a steam train travel, with small floating green "+$19,080" cash numbers popping up. The noob stands bottom right cheering. Title across the top: "SEND CONVOYS"

A giant shining gold medallion in the middle reads "x2.75" in huge numbers, golden light rays behind it, a glowing city on a map below with confetti and a royal wedding arch, a merchant ship racing toward it. The bacon hair on the left pointing at the medallion, amazed. Title across the top: "WORLD EVENTS"
defeat_the_boss

A huge menacing bandit king boss (iron crown, eye patch, ragged brown cloak, curved bronze sword, sack of gold) towers on the right filling half the frame with a red health bar above him, cracked and nearly empty. Small but brave, the bacon hair on the left swings a sword with a glowing white slash. Burning village background. Title across the top: "DEFEAT THE BOSS"

legendary_officer

win_the_war

Layout: battlefield clash. Two cartoon blocky armies charge at each other across a field, blue crown banners on the left, red banners on the right, cannons and dust clouds. The bacon hair leads the blue side in front holding a sword up high. Title across the top: "WIN THE WAR"
top_the_leaderboard

spy_on_rivals

get_rich_laws

alliance_war_room

monarchy_democracy

Layout: two halves side by side with a VS badge in the middle. Left half: the bacon hair as a king on a red velvet throne with a crown. Right half: the noob as president at a podium with a ballot box and a blue flag. Title across the top: "CHOOSE YOUR GOVERNMENT"
biggest_empire

Layout: hero on top of the world. A giant cartoon globe fills the bottom of the frame covered in blue crown flags; the bacon hair stands on top of it with arms crossed and a cape blowing in the wind, sunrise sky behind. Title across the top: "BUILD THE BIGGEST EMPIRE"
raid_alert

Layout: alarm scene. Red alarm lights flash; the noob grabs his head in panic as a blocky enemy army marches toward his small castle; on the right the bacon hair calmly locks a huge bank vault door full of gold, smirking. Title across the top: "PROTECT YOUR CASH"
